name: Ichimiya Cardina
source:
The head of the Far East branch of the "Church", a religious organization that is two sides of the same coin.

As a moral and benevolent priest, he always guides and guides the believers living in the Far East.

[Translated from [url=http://b-cluster.eek.jp/raid/character_detail.html#ichi]official website[/url]]
